name: scancode-latch-neutral
source:
Print Scancode,Scancode
Put Key "a"
Print Inkey$,Scancode

encoding.notes: Literal source words: Scancode=1262, Put Key=1254, Print=0476, Inkey$=00f2. Physical line/string bytes are assembled independently without production helpers.

evidence.notes: Scancode starts at zero and is cleared by reading; ordinary Put Key characters have scan zero. Raw queued events and saved-code consumption/cleanup are covered separately. Source analysis, not an Amiga execution capture.
